arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mutual Pharmaceutical argues federal law requires identical ingredients and warnings.
Bartlett argues New Hampshire law imposes a hybrid design-defect standard.
Justice Sotomayor questioned whether FDA approval creates an absolute liability shield.
Justice Kagan asked how the argument applies to brand-named drugs.
